periods.name: 超能力者用银手铐
periods.summary: Two silver handcuffs engraved with Latin-like spells, bought by Aria as equipment against espers. They become decisive when Aria cuffs Jeanne after Shirayuki cuts Durandal.

evidence.quote: Aria brings two silver handcuffs for superpower users.
Aria fastens the anti-esper cuffs to Jeanne.
